US Confirms Deployment of Space-Based Weapons

The United States has confirmed the deployment of space-based weapons for the first time, citing threats from adversaries. A US Space Command official described the acknowledgment as a landmark moment. The specific nature of these weapons and their capabilities were not detailed in the coverage. The deployment is presented as a response to perceived threats in the space domain.
